'''PA-717 Planetary Assault Goliath''' was a massive-sized [[Skytrooper]], a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. During the [[Invasion of Voss]] in [[3630 BBY]], it was deployed in the middle of [[Voss-Ka]], where it was destroyed by [[Lana Beniko]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
PA-717 Planetary Assault Goliath appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' '''Chapter 1: Wrath and Ruin'''.
